home.work.note: We choose focused products we can finish, then announce them when they are ready.
home.work.noctis_own: proxy client for sing‑box, xray and mihomo
home.work.noctis_lead: Noctis holds your servers and starts the engine each one needs. Only the browser you install it in goes through the tunnel, and the rest of your machine keeps its own connection.
home.work.noctis_f1: Paste a share link or a subscription URL, and the server list refreshes on a schedule
home.work.noctis_f2: Send each site through the tunnel or straight out, by the rules in a profile
home.work.noctis_f3: Starts the engine each server needs from the three it ships with
home.work.aria2t_lead: Aria2t hands your browser downloads to aria2, and you manage the queue and pick the files you want in the extension or in the terminal.
home.work.aria2t_f1: Inspect piece maps, peers and per-file progress when a download stalls
home.work.aria2t_f2: Schedule speed limits and reserve the night for large files
home.work.aria2t_f3: Check finished files with SHA-256 and fetch mismatched data again

home.how.intro: They describe how we decide what to build and when it is ready to ship. Each one is where we start, and we weigh any exception on its merits.
home.how.p1_t: We build the tools we need
home.how.p1_b: Every product so far began with a task one of us could not finish with the tools at hand. We keep using each one on our own machines after release, so its rough edges reach us first.
home.how.p2_b: We care about the small things and keep refining a release until it feels right. We also know when to stop, because a tool that waits for perfection helps nobody.
home.how.p3_t: We read every message with care
home.how.p3_b: Every message reaches a person who reads it in full, whether it reports a problem or suggests an idea. Feedback is the most useful input we get, and it steers what we work on next.
home.how.p4_b: We want our products to look good, and each visual choice has to make the tool easier to read or quicker to use before it stays.
home.how.p5_b: When a well-tested engine already solves the hard problem, we build on it and spend our effort on the parts you touch. When nothing suitable exists, we write that part ourselves.
home.floor.intro: You can hold us to these four promises across every product we release.
home.floor.f1_t: It's yours, and it stays yours
home.floor.f1_b: You can export what you put in as readable data. We do not use it to build a profile of you.
home.floor.f2_b: We put no advertising in our products and take no payment to favor someone else's interests.
home.floor.f3_t: You can read what it does before you trust it
home.floor.f3_b: We document each behavior that can affect your trust, next to the product that performs it.
home.floor.f4_t: It keeps working if we stop
home.floor.f4_b: If we retire a product, installed copies keep working on their current machines. We will announce the decision before support ends.
